item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a credible end-of-year source showing that the crackdown on protests, the treason cases, or the cybercrime pressure on journalists had been structurally reversed by December 2024. The strongest corrective moves were late, reactive, and partial, so the record supports adaptation under pressure, not durable restraint.","evidence":[{"title":"Nigeria Opens Land and Air Borders with Republic of Niger, Lift Other Sanctions","publisher":"State House, Abuja","date":"2024-03-14","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/nigeria-opens-land-and-air-borders-with-republic-of-niger-lift-other-sanctions/","summary":"Tinubu converted ECOWAS pressure into reintegration by lifting sanctions and reopening borders, showing he could switch from punishment to accommodation when that better served regional influence and stability.","question_ids":["8B.9","8B.8"]},{"title":"Nigeria restarts cash transfers to cushion hardship caused by reforms","publisher":"Reuters via reallocated resources to vulnerable households after subsidy removal, a clear tactical adjustment meant to blunt backlash and keep the reform program politically viable.","question_ids":["8B.9","8B.8","8B.7"]},{"title":"Tinubu establishes comprehensive economic coordination and planning system for Nigeria","publisher":"State House, put the finance minister, CBN governor, economists, and private-sector figures at the center of implementation, which is strong evidence of method adaptation and tighter control over execution.","question_ids":["8B.9","8B.8"]},{"title":"President Tinubu’s Broadcast on the Nationwide Protest","publisher":"State deploy, government offers dialogue as protests loom","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-07-31","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economic-indicators/nigeria-security-forces-deploy-government-offers-dialogue-as-protests-loom-3546462","summary":"The government offered dialogue while security forces deployed in major cities, showing a mixed crisis posture that combined negotiation with coercive readiness rather than a clean restraint-first response.","question_ids":["8B.9","8B.8"]},{"title":"President Tinubu directs reorganisation of the Bureau of Public Procurement","publisher":"State House, procurement gatekeeper for efficiency and transparency, which is a direct example of replacing or retooling an implementer to keep the program moving.","question_ids":["8B.9","8B.8"]},{"title":"Nigeria’s Tinubu names seven ministers, sacks five in cabinet reshuffle","publisher":"Reuters via underperformers, and retained finance, defence, and planning, which looks like active executive performance management rather than paralysis.","question_ids":["8B.9","8B.8"]},{"title":"Tinubu orders probe of security agents involved in arrest, detention of minors","publisher":"TheCable","date":"2024-11-04","url":"https://www.thecable.ng/tinubu-orders-probe-of-security-agents-involved-in-arrest-detention-of-minors/","summary":"After backlash, Tinubu ordered an investigation into the detention and treatment of minors and said involved officers could face discipline, showing late but real corrective action after an abuse became politically costly.","question_ids":["8B.9","3B.4","8B.8"]},{"title":"Nigeria charges protesters with treason, inciting military","publisher":"Reuters via management.","question_ids":["8B.9","3B.4"]},{"title":"Nigeria police used excessive force to violently quash #EndBadGovernance protests","publisher":"Amnesty documented killings, mass detentions, and torture during the crackdown, showing that the state’s response preserved control through coercion rather than through a stable, legitimacy-preserving correction.","question_ids":["8B.9","3B.4","8B.8"]},{"title":"Nigeria police charge 4 journalists with cybercrimes for corruption reporting","publisher":"Committee to Protect resistance.","question_ids":["8B.9","7B.1","8B.8"]},{"title":"Nigeria: Freedom on the Net 2024 Country Report","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/nigeria/freedom-net/2024","summary":"Freedom House found no internet shutdowns, which is a weak positive, but also said legal pressure and intimidation continued to chill journalists and activists, so the state did not fully normalize open contestation.","question_ids":["8B.9","7B.1","8B.8"]},{"title":"Tinubu under fire for appointing son-in-law head of housing agency","publisher":"BusinessDay","date":"2024-02-21","url":"https://businessday.ng/news/article/tinubu-under-fire-for-appointing-son-in-law-head-of-housing-agency/","summary":"The son-in-law appointment to the Federal Housing Authority is the clearest patronage signal in the 2024 record and cuts against any clean merit-only or institution-insulated reading.","question_ids":["8B.9","8B.4"]}]}
